q: Can everyone, under normal circumstances, attend meetings in the Folketing chamber?
appeared: It appeared in the June 2020 exam.

da.q: Kan alle under normale omstændigheder overvære møder i folketingssalen?

learn.text: The Folketing's meetings are, as a starting point, public. Anyone can come into the public gallery in the chamber and listen to the debates.

q: Who can be a member of a committee in the Folketing?

options.t: Politicians who are members of the Folketing
Civil servants employed in a ministry

answerText: Politicians who are members of the Folketing
appeared: It appeared in the June 2020 exam.

da.q: Hvem kan være medlem af et udvalg i Folketinget?
options: Politikere, der er medlemmer af Folketinget
Embedsmænd, der er ansat i et ministerium
da.answer: Politikere, der er medlemmer af Folketinget

learn.text: The committees are put together so that each party has a number of committee members that roughly corresponds to the party's size in the Folketing.

q: Which court convicted the former minister for immigration and integration, Inger Støjberg, of illegally separating asylum-seeking couples?
appeared: It appeared in the June 2022 exam.

da.q: Hvilken domstol dømte tidligere udlændinge- og integrationsminister Inger Støjberg for ulovligt at have adskilt asylsøgende par?

learn.text: And in 2021, a former minister for immigration and integration was sentenced to 60 days of unconditional imprisonment for illegally separating asylum-seeking spouses and cohabiting couples at asylum centres. That former minister for immigration and integration was Inger Støjberg, who later founded the party Danmarksdemokraterne, which you met in Chapter One.

q: What did the Folketing's indictment in the impeachment case against the former minister Inger Støjberg concern, among other things?

options.t: Confiscation of refugees' valuables on entry
A temporary stop to family reunifications
Separation of asylum-seeking spouses and cohabiting couples

answerText: Separation of asylum-seeking spouses and cohabiting couples
appeared: It appeared in the June 2021 exam.

da.q: Hvad omhandler Folketingets tiltale i rigsretssagen mod tidligere udlændinge- og integrationsmini- ster Inger Støjberg blandt andet?
options: Beslaglæggelse af flygtninges værdigenstande ved indrejse
Adskillelse af asylsøgende ægtefæller og samlevende par
da.answer: Adskillelse af asylsøgende ægtefæller og samlevende par
